coverage.not_covered: Every other release-bearing surface in the repository is NOT yet inventoried. This manifest is a bounded first increment and is not the complete WS-00 release-surface inventory. External repositories were not inspected.

field_semantics.presence: on-main: every path, entrypoint, test, owner and ci_lane file must exist with exact case in the git tree of baseline_ref AND in the checkout under test. branch-only: each candidate records PR, branch and full head SHA; nothing is checked against main and no fetch is made. external-not-inspected: no path recorded, no check.
field_semantics.source_presence: yes: source exists in this repository at baseline_ref. branch-only: source exists only on the recorded PR branches. unknown: not inspected, so presence is neither claimed nor denied.
field_semantics.canonical_status: Ownership decision, kept separate from presence and evidence. canonical / candidate / unresolved. This manifest does not ratify ownership; candidate and unresolved keep competing implementations visible.
field_semantics.runtime_evidence: none / tests-only / certified-lane:<lane-name>. tests-only means tests exist on disk; it does not assert they were run or pass.
field_semantics.verified_ref: on-main entries only: must equal baseline_ref. Branch-only evidence is each candidate's head_sha.
field_semantics.owner: UNKNOWN, or dox:<path of the AGENTS.md whose scope contains the surface>.
field_semantics.ci_lane: UNKNOWN, or the workflow files that run some of the entry's tests. Presence of a workflow file does not mean every listed test is covered.

entries.notes: Howard is approval-gated, evidence-intake only. artifacts/convergence/mission-wiring/CONVERGENCE-DUPLICATES-001.md records agents/ as orphaned (zero production importers). Listed tests are root-level agent unit tests; not exhaustive.

entries.notes: Per Increment Two, agent runtime authority is UNRESOLVED. SP-COMPLETION-MAP-001 directs extending agent_runtime typed manifests rather than creating another agent registry; this manifest is not an agent registry.

entries.notes: Brought under the GOD-1 authority envelope by baseline commits 08060be7 and 051e2594. swarm-runtime-ci.yml runs named acceptance tests, not necessarily every test in swarm_runtime/tests.
